memories.text: In 1997 Bisola told Kunle "ok, lez go back to me being ure boss", and the egbe still holds that line like a promise nobody signed.
memories.author: thryd

memories.text: Ejiro pointed at the code of the juju and Kunle said it pained him that she won it first; the ttb keeps the score.
memories.author: thryd

memories.text: Kunle asked Ejiro "if i was a worm, you will love me?" and the isl wrote the question down without an answer.
memories.author: thryd

memories.text: 6:35am, 14 March 2053: Taiwo stopped counting coins mid-tin when the [[ac]] code ran, and Bisola left her jollof untouched on the counter.
memories.author: thryd

memories.text: 11:10am, 19 August 2054: Bisola held blue glass beads to the light while Taiwo weighed a bag on the brass scale, and four miracles were logged before the needle settled.
memories.author: thryd

memories.text: 7:40am, 12 January 2056: Taiwo washed his hands before taking the ring of keys from Bisola at the Gbagi Street shutter.
memories.author: thryd

memories.text: At 4:25pm the Yaba bookshop kept a receipt in the brown envelope with a senator story and a construction friend on it, and someone wrote [[love]] across it.
memories.author: thryd

memories.text: At 10:15am the Ikeja laundromat kept the green shirt that was not Bisola's, and it came out of the dryer humming callmemaybe.
memories.author: thryd

memories.text: At 3:50pm the Lekki pharmacy watched Bisola hold a paper bag she would not open, while someone drew a line nobody should cross.
memories.author: thryd
